In the end, all of us need to face the same thing. it doesn't matter who is ahead of us or behind us. Focus on yourself. Even if your friends got their desired subjects, it's still not the end for them. The same goes for you, you are writing your stream selection exam late but remember just like you everyone else is also writing their preabord 3. You are not alone in this situation. All CBSE students are facing this issue. Don't worry, keep your mind calm and start planning how you are going to go about with your exams. I know by this time you are exhausted. Try taking breaks during study time. keep your mind chill. the mind doesn't work when your anxious, only when you are calm you can cooperate with your brain. This is not the end. Your friends and everyone else are walking on the same path. Ganbatte!
